method: Development-time assistant review of every record in each deterministic, template-stratified review sample, including Gurmukhi, English and selected source senses. This is not independent human/native review. The full corpus is separately screened by the frozen explicit rubric. Sparse exceptions below override the reviewed default of plausible meaning, accurate translation and natural wording; uncertainty is never counted as a confirmed error.

criteria.validity: Logical, ordinarily plausible Punjabi meaning and grammatical construction; unestablished special contexts are uncertain.
criteria.translation: Selected dictionary sense, semantic roles, aspect, English agreement, determiners and quantity wording match the Punjabi sentence.
criteria.naturalness: Ordinary English wording without unnecessary technical/dictionary labels or unsupported discourse assumptions.
criteria.sampling: Up to six evenly spaced distinct main-corpus slots per enabled template, excluding quoted-word practice. Withdrawn final regression slots use seeded, outcome-independent replacements from the same template. Descriptive sample rates, not population estimates or fluent-speaker certification.
